Choose one character on your opponent's front line and sideline it.

card_set: BOOSTER PACK The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You [UE21BT]
card_text: Choose one character on your field. It gains 3000 BP and 【Snipe】 (You may target a character on your opponent's front line and attack it with this character. If you do, your opponent cannot block) until the end of the turn. If <Kusuri Yakuzen> is on your field, you may place one card from your hand into your sideline. If you do, reduce the AP cost of the next event card with 2 or less required energy you use from your hand this turn by 1.
